_comment: Purchasable/usable items. Effect kinds: 'restrain_hit' caps a single hit's damage against a wild creature at cap_ratio * its max HP, for the rest of the current battle -- it does not stop a creature from being finished off over several hits, only from being ended in one. 'heal' restores percent% of a creature's max HP. 'revive' brings a fainted creature back at percent% of max HP and is deliberately not usable_in_battle. 'restore_uses' puts 'uses' back into every move a creature knows, each capped at its own maximum -- the only way to top moves up away from a spring. See docs/DESIGN.md sections 13, 19, 23 and 31.

items.name: Tempering Draught
items.description: Steadies the hand. For the rest of this fight, no single blow you land can end it outright.

items.name: Knitbone Salve
items.description: Comfrey root and tallow, packed cold. Closes what it can reach.

items.name: Waking Root
items.description: Bitter enough to argue with. Brings back one that has gone down, halfway.

items.name: Ninebark Tonic
items.description: Bark boiled down past bitter. Gives back some of what a long day took out.

items.name: Heartwood Root
items.description: Cut from the middle of the tree, where the tree keeps what it cannot spare. Brings one back whole.
